The /backtests/export/logs API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

text/plain - Logs of the backtest.
content string
One log line per row.
Example 
2024-01-02 00:00:00 Launching analysis for 26c7bb06b8487cff1c7b3c44652b30f1 with LEAN Engine v2.5.0.0.18198
2024-01-02 16:00:00 Algorithm started

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
